The raster title block is dated 2025-03-21. FIS warns that viewer imagery is no longer maintained and may differ from the current CAD vault; no post-publication remodeling guarantee is made.

Only three explicitly numbered classroom polygons and the simplified basement outer envelope are traced. Small door, jamb, column and wall-thickness details are omitted; rounded corners are approximated with short line segments.

The basement outer envelope replaces a repeated campus-roof silhouette. The open light court is included within the simplified overall basement envelope; no ceiling, circulation mesh, interior courtyard walls or upper-floor room geometry is reconstructed.
Registration inherits the approximate campus transform. Control/holdout residuals and room-area agreement are drawing consistency checks, not a surveyed accuracy claim.
All five upper floors, their room lists, estimated heights and sources are retained unchanged. Their existing outlines remain campus-derived approximations, not newly reviewed floor plans.
Source room labels carry the E wing prefix (EB90/EB91/EB92); schedule keys B90/B91/B92 are preserved only through the reviewed Facilities room-ID crosswalk.
